notes.title: Our new game the Steam store page for 'Bait Soul' is now live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Players,[/b][/h1]

[h2]Happy New Year! We’re excited to finally share our new game — Bait Soul — with you at this special time![/h2]

Bait Soul is a top-down action roguelike where players can freely combine various elements to create their own ultimate combat style. Explore the unknown depths and face waves of formidable enemies in a challenging journey.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484100/_Bait_Soul/

Currently, we are working hard to develop and refine the game, and we look forward to sharing the demo with you soon.

Though the official release is still some time away, we’ll continue to share the latest updates and progress with you. Be sure to follow us for the latest development news, and feel free to share your valuable feedback and suggestions to help us create a better game together.

[b][h2]- BOLD FISH -[/h2][/b]

notes.title: Reinstatement of the Game Page
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

Recently, due to our publisher BD GAMES violating regulations and being banned, all their games, including ours, were taken down. The specific reasons remain unclear to us. When we signed with the publisher, we handed over all operational permissions to them so we could focus on game development. We never expected such a situation to occur. We have since terminated our partnership with BD GAMES, and future releases of "Life is Not Auto" will be managed directly by us.

Although we don’t know the exact actions taken by the publisher, judging by the comments, we believe at least these comments are genuine. We received a total of 97 comments, which are the most valuable asset for “Life is Not Auto” We are grateful to Steam for preserving these comments.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1995810/reviews/?p=1&browsefilter=mostrecent&filterLanguage=all]View Comments[/url]

“Life is Not Auto” is clearly not a commercially successful game, but creating it, having players play it, and receiving comments is already a great success for us. These comments give us the strength to continue making games, especially during times of confusion and self-doubt. We are very thankful to all of you, to everyone who has played and supported our game.

This incident has deeply saddened us. This is our debut work, the result of a year and a half of effort from our team. This piece should exist under our boldfish portfolio, be findable, and playable. This is our history.

Once again, thank you all for your support and understanding.

[b]The boldfish Team[/b]
